jobs.description: Piping Foreman Job Description As Piping Foreman at Emtes Workforce you are responsible for the coordinating and managing pipefitters and welders on-site within the (petro)chemical, food and pharmaceutical industry . You monitor the progress, quality, and safety of the work and are the point of contact for both the team and project management. What are your duties?  - Leading a team of pipefitters and welders . - Coordinating daily activities at the project site. - Reading and interpreting isometric drawings and technical drawings. - Monitoring the progress, quality, and safety of the project. - Reporting to the project leader and ensuring efficient collaboration on the work floor. - Actively contribute to a safe working environment and compliance with safety regulations. What is expected of you?  - Minimum 5 years of experience in a leadership position within the piping sector. - Experience in the (petro)chemical, food or pharmaceutical industry . - Excellent command of Dutch or English language . - Able to read and interpret technical drawings and diagrams. - Strong communication and organizational skills. - In possession of a valid VCA-VOL certificate or willing to obtain it. - Driving license B is a plus. What do we offer you?  - Weekly payment of your salary. - Long-term projects with stability and security. - Accommodation and international transport can be arranged. - Opportunities for personal and professional development. - A dynamic work environment with experienced colleagues. About Emtes Workforce: Emtes Workforce is a leading supplier of technical personnel for industrial projects. We guarantee quality, safety, and reliability and offer our professionals challenging and sustainable career opportunities. Interested? Send your CV and cover letter to recruitment@emtes.eu or contact us by phone at +31 (0)6 27 00 38 38 Apply for the position: Piping Foreman
